title: Application::Run() entered without Set-StrictMode -Off — StrictMode bleeds into all event handlers
description: P024 documents StrictMode bleed via ShowDialog(). The same bleed occurs when [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::Run() is called without first issuing Set-StrictMode -Off. Application::Run() drives the WinForms message pump, dispatching ALL event handler scriptblocks (timer ticks, menu clicks, form events) from within the calling thread and call stack. If Set-StrictMode -Version Latest is active at the call site, every $script: variable access inside ANY registered handler is evaluated under strict mode — causing 'variable cannot be retrieved because it has not been set' errors for variables that are legitimately set in a different scope or not yet initialized at tick time. This is functionally identical to P024 but triggered by Application::Run() rather than ShowDialog().
ps_version_scope_note: Affects PS5.1 Desktop WinForms. PS7 Core WinForms may be similar — treat as BOTH until confirmed.
detection_method: Scan for Application]::Run() — check that Set-StrictMode -Off appears within 15 lines before the call
remedy:
Wrap Application::Run() in StrictMode toggle:
  BEFORE: [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::Run()
  AFTER:
    Set-StrictMode -Off
    try { [System.Windows.Forms.Application]::Run() } finally { Set-StrictMode -Version Latest }
trusted_fix_notes: Applied in Start-LocalWebEngineService.ps1 Start-ServiceTray function (2026-05-22). Set-StrictMode -Off before Application::Run(), restored in finally block.
